<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/delivery.ts -->
<!--
  Delivery zones and their prices as a table or as cards: the zone and its areas, the price, the order that
  ships free, the minimum order, the time and an express badge. Axes: layout (table, cards), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Zone, ZoneLabels } from "./zone-table.types";

export type ZoneTableProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  zones: Zone[];
  labels: ZoneLabels;
  layout?: "table" | "cards";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import List from "../primitives/list/list.vue";
import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import ZoneRows from "../components/zone-rows.vue";
import { fmtMoney } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  zones,
  labels,
  layout = "table",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<ZoneTableProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :density="density">
    <ZoneRows v-if="((layout as string) === 'table')" :zones="zones" :labels="labels" />
    <Grid v-else cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <Stack
        v-for="z in zones"
        :key="z.id"
        gap="4"
        class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
            {{ z.name }}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {{ z.area }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
          {{ fmtMoney(z.price, z.currency) }}
        </Text>
        <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2 border-t border-border pt-4">
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.freeFrom }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(z.freeFrom, z.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.minOrder }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ fmtMoney(z.minOrder, z.currency) }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
          <ListItem class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 text-sm">
            <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ labels.time }}
            </Inline>
            <Inline class="font-medium">
              {{ z.time }}
            </Inline>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
        <Badge v-if="z.express" variant="secondary" size="default" class="w-fit">
          {{ z.express }}
        </Badge>
      </Stack>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
